$schema: Captain risk register — existential and operational risks with mitigation status
review_cadence: monthly (last full review 2026-11-24; the register was not reviewed between 2026-05-12 and now)

risks.title: Anthropic price hike or service interruption
risks.description: Anthropic changes Claude Max pricing or terms, or has an outage. Envelope today is Max $100/mo, subscription-only (no usage credits, no API-key spend beyond the plan's included credits, each capped in code). The engine consumed 4.8M fresh tokens + 245M cache reads on 2026-11-24 alone, so plan-limit throttling is as likely as a price move.
risks.mitigation: Spend tracked in the run ledger and `economy`; cost routes to cheaper lanes (delegation rule). The old 'pay-as-you-go fallback' is dropped: it conflicts with the subscription-only policy. Fallback lanes: Antigravity (`a`), opencode (`o`).

risks.title: Abdout key-person risk
risks.description: Abdout is the only engineer in the git history of every active repo. Commits since 2026-10-25: mkan 307, kun 230, hogwarts 191, farm 378, machine 134, space 39, android-app 23, food 15, ios-app 3, catalog 2 - all under one author identity; no other author appears in any repo. If he is unavailable for 2 weeks every product stops.
risks.mitigation: Unchanged in intent: second-engineer onboarding (Ibrahim), docs, captain autonomy. The git record shows no commits by Ibrahim or Moutaz in any local repo, so the mitigation is not evidenced; either they push elsewhere or it is not happening. Needs a human check.
risks.review_note: Worsened: likelihood 2 to 3 (judgment) because the onboarding mitigation shows no activity.

risks.title: Sudan banking / sanctions / currency
risks.description: Sudan-based clients cannot easily pay in USD. Payment route for the first invoice is still open (SAR transfer or Bankak, account owed; Sedon due 2026-11-24). Al-Ibda is Sudan-based with a Dammam branch; KSA schools pay SAR by bank transfer. SDG moves between invoice and payment.
risks.mitigation: Price quoted in SAR, paid in SDG at the bank rate on the day (D-20261117). Sedon's Saudi bank + Bankak route; confirm an account that can receive the first payment before the contract is sent.
risks.review_note: Applies; first-payment path is the live instance.

risks.title: SSPL procurement rejection
risks.description: Large institutional buyers (universities, ministries, district offices) may reject SSPL due to legal/procurement policies that disallow it. This caps the addressable market at private schools and SMBs.
risks.mitigation: Acceptable for now — private schools are the beachhead and SSPL is the strategic posture (Counter-Positioning per Helmer). If/when district sales become a priority, evaluate dual-license offering.
risks.review_note: Applies, unchanged. No institutional buyer has been approached; all active deals are private schools.

risks.title: No paying customer within 6 months (TRIGGERED 2026-11-12)
risks.description: The condition in the original text occurred: no signed deal by 2026-11-12 (north star 0 on 2026-11-24; Q3 target missed). Capital last verified 2026-04-02; estimated 2-5 months of runway.
risks.mitigation: Wartime mode per the 3-month trigger: stop list in the 2026-11-22 week plan (mkan and engine work stop until the Al-Ibda signature). Weekly review tracks the signature; premortem/decision on the 2026-11-30 miss line in D-20261108.

risks.title: Pilot fails silently - a school disengages
risks.description: Occurred with King Fahad Schools (pilot Apr-Oct went dormant, 14 students, never took attendance; came back 2026-10-21 but still 0 attendance). Same exposure now for Alwafi (4 students, never started) and for Al-Ibda if the signature slips, though Al-Ibda is active (971 attendance marks in 7 days).
risks.mitigation: Weekly activity read from production (north_star weekly_history). Owner moves to Moutaz (King Fahad) and Abdout (Al-Ibda); the Ahmed Baha check-in line is obsolete. Add last-contact dates to customers.json when the CRM is current.
risks.review_note: Re-scoped from 'Ahmed Baha' to the pilot cohort; materialized once already.

risks.title: Sedon part-time bottleneck on Saudi ops
risks.description: Sedon (15 h/week, Saudi-resident) now sits on the critical path of the first cash: payment route for Al-Ibda's first invoice, and on-call (first reply within 2 hours) for Al-Ibda to 2026-11-26. Hours are the 07-02 figure, not re-verified.
risks.mitigation: Document Sedon's procedures so others could pick up if needed. Batch his tasks Mon/Wed/Fri (already in place). At MRR ≥ $5K, consider a second Saudi operator (or paid PEO).
risks.review_note: Likelihood 2 to 3: his tasks now gate revenue. Still medium.

risks.title: Dispatch drift: drafts and handoffs that never reach people
risks.description: The channel is no longer only Apple Notes: it is Hermes/Slack and the 'المدرسة 2.0' WhatsApp group, with drafts staged in ~/.claude/state/team/outbox. Drafts 01-05 (the Al-Ibda offer, announcement, sprint 1, Bakri meeting) were still unsent on 2026-11-21 and the offer text was stale (USD terms). aware.md shows 6 handoffs to Cowork and 11 decision reviews due.
risks.mitigation: Every outbox draft carries a send date and an owner; weekly review lists unsent drafts; the sender confirms in the group. The 24h/72h escalation gate is not evidenced to be running.
risks.review_note: Re-scoped from Apple Notes to the real channels; score up 6 to 12.

risks.title: Runway is an unverified estimate
risks.description: Capital $5,000 was last verified 2026-04-02; burn $500/mo has not been verified since April and its breakdown is stale. Arithmetic on the file's own inputs gives ~2.2 months, the 2026-11-08 estimate says 3-5. D-20261117 puts full cost at $2,700-4,000/mo, a different basis. Every trigger decision (6/3/1 months) is made on a guess.
risks.mitigation: Abdout supplies cash on hand and the real monthly costs (asked 2026-11-08); runway.json months_remaining stays null until then (Q4 O3-KR1, due 2026-11-27).

risks.title: Single-customer and single-product dependency
risks.description: The north star rests on one unsigned school (Al-Ibda). The next three deals have no attendance and overdue next actions. Effort does not match the metric: in 30 days mkan had 307 commits and hogwarts 191, while the stop list says mkan stops until the signature lands.
risks.mitigation: Company-of-One refusal line (docs/NORTH-STAR.md): growth work that does not move the paying-school count is refused. Q4 O1/O2 put both signatures on dated KRs.

risks.title: CI never green on hogwarts main; mkan red 8 days
risks.description: aware.md 2026-11-24: hogwarts main CI failed (Playwright), never green; mkan main CI red 8 days; supervisor has open issues on hogwarts perf/keep-cache-warm and a readiness-digest cron. The client product ships with no passing gate while a paying school is about to depend on it.
risks.mitigation: Q4 O3-KR3: hogwarts main green by 2026-11-26. Until then a manual /check + /watch before every deploy that Al-Ibda sees.

risks.title: Registry and engine drift
risks.description: The repo registry pointed at wrong checkouts until commit f857216 (re-pointed 2026-11-24). Engine sync is overdue (anthropic 23 d, stack/services/practice 59 d, self 23 d), the dispatch bench is 22 days old against a 7-day cadence, and the skill listing is over its 34,600 budget. Files in ~/.claude/memory and kun/.claude/memory were duplicated copies (not links) and were identical only by luck.
risks.mitigation: Run /sync and /bench in an attended session; keep one canonical copy of the state files (kun repo) and sync to ~/.claude/memory by setup.sh only.

risks.title: Live-class infrastructure fails during Al-Ibda's first paid weeks
risks.description: Al-Ibda is an online school; live classes run on LiveKit (self-hosting on Hetzner decided 2026-11-09; LiveKit Cloud free plan has a 5,000 participant-minute cap shared by all schools). The review of that decision was due 2026-11-23 and six sign-in/class-entry reports (11-03 to 11-16) are undecided. An outage in class is the fastest way to lose the signature.
risks.mitigation: Sedon on-call to 2026-11-26; Ibrahim phone test (sign-in by code, join a class) on Android and iOS by 2026-11-24; decide the Al-Ibda reports.

impact.2: Moderate (one month of work or $500-2K loss)

score_thresholds.11-15: High — captain dispatches alert if delta worsens

review_summary_2026-11-24: R-001..R-008 reviewed and all still apply: R-005 triggered, R-006 materialized, R-002/R-007/R-008 worsened or re-scoped. R-009..R-013 added. Scores on changed likelihoods are judgment, not measurement.
